basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Jhajjar Project Technical Staff III Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Radiation Oncology, National Cancer Institute, All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Jhajjar has invited applications for one Project Technical Staff III post on contract basis in the project "Hypofractionated Radiotherapy in Cervical Cancer: A Non-inferiority Randomized Controlled Trial (HYPO-RT-CC)", Project Number N-2707. The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 36,400. The essential qualification is a minimum three-year graduate degree in a relevant field plus 3 years of post-qualification experience, or a postgraduate degree in the relevant subject or field. Inter

how_to_apply: Fill the Google form with your brief information by 5.30 PM on 18.11.2026. The notice says this information is required for shortlisting.
Alternatively, send your request with your CV and cover letter to [email protected] or [email protected]. The notice also gives a QR code for the application.
The notice does not print the Google form address in its text, so use the QR code on the notice or the link on the official website.
important_instructions: The engagement is on contract basis in the project, at a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 36,400. Age relaxation is as per AIIMS/ICMR rules; the notice prints no category-wise details. Only shortlisted candidates will receive interview details, by email. The notice says it will be circulated to ten medical colleges and universities in New Delhi, including Vardhaman Mahavir Medical College and Safdarjung Hospital, University College of Medical Sciences, Lady Hardinge Medical College, Maulana Azad Medical College, Dr. Ram Manohar Lohiya Hospital, Jamia Milia Islamia, Baba Saheb Ambedkar Medical College, ESIC Dental College and Hospital, North Delhi Municipal College Medical College and University of Delhi.

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The post is on contract basis in the HYPO-RT-CC trial, run by the Department of Radiation Oncology of the National Cancer Institute at AIIMS Jhajjar. The Primary Investigator is Dr Karun Kamboj. The notice names the project number as N-2707 and prints the contact block as "Project Investigator - HYPORT-CC".

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for one post only. The qualification and experience below are printed for Project Technical Staff III. The age limit is 35 Years, with relaxation as per AIIMS/ICMR rules. The notice prints no date for counting age. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Minimum of three-year graduate degree in a relevant field + 3 years of post-qualification experience, OR Postgraduate degree in the relevant subject/field.
rows.desirable: At least 2 years' experience in basic sciences or health sciences and preferably 3 months experience working in a clinical trial.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jhajjar Project Technical Staff III
content_sections.text: Fill the Google form with your brief information by 5.30 PM on 18.11.2026. The notice says this information is required for shortlisting. Alternatively, send your request with your CV and cover letter to [email protected] or [email protected] . The notice also gives a QR code for the application. The notice does not print the Google form address in its text, so use the QR code on the notice or the link on the official website. Documents named in the notice: CV Cover letter

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The information in the Google form is used to shortlist candidates. The interview will be held in offline mode. Interview details will be sent only to shortlisted candidates through email.

content_sections.heading: Important Dates
content_sections.text: The interview date is not printed. It will be communicated by email to shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Jhajjar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Project Technical Staff III in the HYPO-RT-CC project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The Google form must be filled latest by 5.30 PM on 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Project Technical Staff III?
faq.answer: A minimum three-year graduate degree in a relevant field plus 3 years of post-qualification experience, OR a postgraduate degree in the relevant subject or field.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 Years, with relaxation as per AIIMS/ICMR rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Project Technical Staff III at AIIMS Jhajjar?
Q6. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the Google form with your brief information by the last date. You can also send your request with CV and cover letter to [email protected] or [email protected], or use the QR code on the notice.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted from the information in the Google form, and an offline interview follows. Interview details are sent only to shortlisted candidates by email.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent post?
faq.answer: No, the notice calls it a contractual vacancy: the post is on contract basis in the HYPO-RT-CC project.

faq.question: Q9. What experience is desirable?
faq.answer: The notice lists at least 2 years' experience in basic sciences or health sciences, and preferably 3 months experience working in a clinical trial.
